technique_name: Create a 3-5 sentence description of the painting.
description: "The Starry Night" by Vincent Van Gogh is a timeless depiction of a starlit sky over a rural village symbolizing uncertainty, beauty and mystery. The painting was created in 1889, during Van Gogh's time in the asylum in Saint-Remy-de-Provence, and displays an exquisite blend of blues, greens and yellows that intermingle along with the movement of the stars and the village below. The iconic painting is a classic example of Van Gogh's innovative use of color, light and movement to convey emotion a
